intents.name: how_to_play
templates:
🚀 *Quick start*
1️⃣ .set name YourName
2️⃣ .role — pick Mafia, Hitman or Businessman
3️⃣ .crime / .biz — earn cash
4️⃣ .bank — stash it
5️⃣ .menu — see everything

Start here {name}:
▸ .set name YourName (register)
▸ .role (pick your path)
▸ .crime (earn cash)
▸ .biz (build an empire)
▸ .menu (full list)

intents.name: register_help
templates:
🪪 Register with:
.set name YourName
One word, 3–20 characters, unique. It's permanent (Name Change Card later if you must).

intents.name: role_select
templates:
🎭 Pick your path with .role <name>:
▸ *Mafia* — crew, rackets, protection
▸ *Hitman* — contracts, stalks, silent takedowns
▸ *Businessman* — fronts, laundering, passive income
Then .class to see your class perks.

intents.name: role_mafia
templates: 🕴️ *Mafia* runs the streets: recruit crew (.recruit), run rackets (.racket), intimidate rivals and claim territory. Crew upkeep is real — feed them or lose them.

intents.name: role_hitman
templates: 🎯 *Hitman* lives by contracts: take hits (.contracts), stalk targets (.stalk), build signature kills and finish with .silent. Precision pays.

intents.name: role_businessman
templates: 💼 *Businessman* builds empires: buy fronts (.biz buy), collect daily (.collect), launder cash (.launder) and hire bodyguards (.hire). Passive income king.

intents.name: money_tips
templates:
💰 *Money moves*
▸ .crime — quick cash, quick heat
▸ .biz + .collect — passive income
▸ .crypto — buy low, sell high
▸ .daily — free money every day
▸ .heist — high risk, high reward
